import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import Client, FastMCPTransport
from fastmcp.resources import ResourceContent


async def main():
    # Create a FastMCP server
    server = FastMCP(name="config-server")
    
    # Register a resource at URI "data://config"
    @server.resource("data://config")
    def get_config() -> ResourceContent:
        return ResourceContent(
            text='{"app": "my_app", "version": "1.0.0", "debug": true}'
        )
    
    # Create an in-memory transport connected to the server
    transport = FastMCPTransport(server)
    
    # Create a client using the in-memory transport
    client = Client(transport)
    
    # Connect and read the resource
    async with client:
        # Read the resource at URI "data://config"
        contents = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        
        # Print the resource contents
        for content in contents:
            print("Resource URI:", content.uri)
            print("Content:", content.text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
